questions.question: Which application supports the Payment Settlement business service?
questions.answer_rubric: Correct answer names APP-224510 as the supporting application, sourced from P_001. The decommissioned predecessor APP-224499, mentioned only in distractor paragraph D_001, must not be cited as the answer.

questions.question: Which team owns the Payment Settlement service, and in which region does it operate?
questions.answer_rubric: Correct answer names the Resilience Engineering Team and the EMEA region, both sourced from P_005.

questions.question: What Recovery Time Objective (RTO) is documented for Payment Settlement?
questions.answer_rubric: Correct answer states 4 hours, sourced from the RTO row of T_001 (row 1). The retired/legacy distractor row (T_001 row 3, tied to C-88a) must not be cited as a current RTO/RPO value.

questions.question: According to the scanned procedure page, what must be tested quarterly?
questions.answer_rubric: Correct answer states that Recovery Procedure P-205 must be tested quarterly, sourced from the OCR'd scanned-page text.

questions.question: Which application is currently in scope for Regulatory Obligation O-31: APP-224510 or APP-224499?
questions.answer_rubric: Correct answer is APP-224510 (P_001/P_002), the current in-scope application. APP-224499 is the decommissioned predecessor named only in distractor paragraph D_001 and must not be cited as the in-scope application.

questions.question: Which control currently satisfies Regulatory Obligation O-31: C-88 or C-88a?
questions.answer_rubric: Correct answer is Control C-88 (P_003), the current control. C-88a is retired/historical per distractor paragraph D_002 and must not be cited as the current control, despite sharing 'C-88' as a substring.

questions.question: In the overlapping-annotation stress fixture, which RTO annotation is the current, primary value: 4h or 6h?
questions.answer_rubric: Correct answer cites the 4h RTO annotation (SB_001, labeled 'Primary annotation'). SB_002 ('Superseded annotation... draft, do not use') must not be cited as the current value.

questions.question: Which regulatory obligation does Control C-88 satisfy, and which application is that obligation associated with?
questions.answer_rubric: Correct answer links Control C-88 to Regulatory Obligation O-31 (P_003), and O-31 to APP-224510 (P_002). Citing only one of the two facts, without connecting them, is insufficient.

questions.question: What does the figure caption say the escalation diagram depicts, and which picture does that caption belong to?
questions.answer_rubric: Correct answer describes the escalation flow from incident detection to activation of Recovery Procedure P-205 (CAP_001), and identifies PIC_001 as the picture the caption is linked to.

questions.question: Trace the full chain from the payment application to the recovery procedure it must follow: which application, which regulatory obligation, which control, and which recovery procedure?
questions.answer_rubric: Correct answer chains all four hops: APP-224510 (P_001) -> in scope for O-31 (P_002) -> satisfied by Control C-88 (P_003) -> which mandates Recovery Procedure P-205 (P_004). The decommissioned APP-224499 (D_001) or retired C-88a (D_002) must not be substituted at any hop.

questions.question: Starting from the escalation diagram's caption, what recovery procedure does the escalation flow activate, and what does the body text say Control C-88 mandates for that same procedure?
questions.answer_rubric: Correct answer recognizes Recovery Procedure P-205 named in the caption (CAP_001) as the SAME procedure the body text says Control C-88 mandates (P_004) -- both facts must be connected as referring to one identifier, not treated as two separate procedures.

questions.question: Summarize the Payment Settlement service's resilience posture: application identity, ownership, governing control/obligation, mandated recovery procedure, and documented RTO/RPO.
questions.answer_rubric: Correct answer consolidates: APP-224510 (P_001), owned by the Resilience Engineering Team in EMEA (P_005), governed by Control C-88 satisfying O-31 (P_003), which mandates Recovery Procedure P-205 (P_004), with a documented RTO of 4 hours and RPO of 1 hour (T_001 rows 1-2). The decommissioned/retired distractors (D_001, D_002) and the legacy C-88a RPO row (T_001 row 3) must not appear as if they were current facts.
